objective: The primary nav becomes an icon bar on phones and a left sidebar from 640 px, with Sign out moved into it; Search moves to the header on phones, and the account avatar sits at the header's right end.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: FRONTEND-032 and FRONTEND-033 have merged to main, and no other open PR writes src/routes/AppLayout*. Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation; the implementation commit edits no test.

The nav is rendered once, as <nav aria-label="Primary">, a sibling after the header and before main, no longer inside the header. Its items in DOM order: Home (/, renamed from Feed), Stats, Search, Notifications, then Sign out. Each link keeps its href and aria-current rule (Stats is still current on /players/*), and each item has an aria-hidden icon.

Sign out is a button, the nav list's last item, shown under the same rule as the header button it replaces: a restored session whose account is not deactivated. Pressing it signs out and moves focus to main, as today. The header has no Sign out button any more.

Below 40em (phones): the nav is the bar fixed to the bottom, showing Home, Stats, Notifications and Sign out as icons only. Labels are visually hidden with the shared visually-hidden class, so each accessible name is the label. The nav's Search item is display: none. Each cell is at least --target-min tall, and main's bottom padding still clears the bar and the floating buttons (floating-clearance.test.ts).

Below 40em the header holds, at its end, a Search icon link to /search (accessible name Search, aria-current on /search) immediately left of the Account menu button, or of Sign in for an anonymous visitor. From 40em this header link is display: none. These two Search links are the one deliberate exception to layout.md §1 (decisions.md, 2026-11-05): at any width exactly one is rendered visibly, and tests scope Search queries with within() to the header or the nav.

Header at every width: the brand link at the start; at the end the Account menu button for an active account, or Sign in for an anonymous visitor not on /sign-in. The menu keeps its name, items and behaviour.

From 40em: the nav is a sticky left sidebar under the header, var(--sidebar-width-compact) wide (4.5rem), icon only, listing Home, Stats, Search, Notifications and Sign out in that order. Each item is at least --target-min square, with a visible focus ring.

From 78em the sidebar is var(--sidebar-width) wide (12rem), each item an icon then its visible label at --font-size-md on one row, at least --target-min tall. From 72em to 78em it stays icon only, even where FRONTEND-036's rail is shown.

The current item, in the bar and the sidebar: weight 600, --color-text, and a 3px --color-action bar (on the top edge in the phone bar, on the inline-start edge in the sidebar), drawn as a border so forced-colors mode keeps it. Non-current items are --color-text-muted. Sign out never carries aria-current.
From 40em the sidebar and main sit together as one group centred in the viewport, with --space-5 between them. main keeps --content-max, and /stats/records keeps --content-max-wide.
tokens.css adds --sidebar-width-compact: 4.5rem, --sidebar-width: 12rem and --rail-width: 18rem (the last for FRONTEND-036), and tokens.test.ts pins them.
A LogOutIcon is added to components/ui/icons from Lucide, the existing set, under its licence and in the same way as the other icons.

No horizontal overflow: scrollWidth equals clientWidth at 320, 360, 640, 1024, 1152, 1248, 1280 and 1920 CSS px, each with a classic 17px scrollbar, signed in and anonymous, on /, /stats/records and /notifications.
The skip link is still the first focusable element and moves focus to main. Tab order: brand, header Search (phones only), Account menu or Sign in, then the nav items in order, then main.

Browser rows at 360, 1024, 1280 and 1920, light and dark, signed in and anonymous, reported with measurements or NOT DONE: the phone bar's four icons; the header's Search beside the avatar on phones; the sidebar at each width; Sign out from the bar and from the sidebar; the current item on /stats, a player page and /search; keyboard through header and nav; 200% text size at 360 and 1280; the compose dialog open.

frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/FRONTEND-035.ts declares, in the test commit, every output the unit changes. Entry growth is at most 2 KiB raw and 1 KiB gzip, and no output reaches 500,000 raw bytes.
No new dependency, third-party request, image file, or raw colour or px font size in module CSS.
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md records the shell's new shape.
